lengalengas.title: Eeny, Meeny, Miny, Moe
lengalengas.text:
Eeny, meeny, miny, moe,
Catch a tiger by the toe,
If he hollers let him go,
Eeny, meeny, miny, moe!

lengalengas.title: Rain, Rain, Go Away
lengalengas.text:
Rain, rain, go away,
Come again another day,
Little children want to play,
Rain, rain, go away!

lengalengas.title: One, Two, Three
lengalengas.text:
One, two, three,
Four, five, six,
Seven, eight, nine, ten,
Now let's count again!

lengalengas.title: Away Goes the Mouse
lengalengas.text:
Away goes the mouse down the street,
With his tail bouncing neat,
Run, run, fast and quick,
The kittens chase him double-quick!

lengalengas.title: One Little Hen
lengalengas.text:
One little hen in the yard,
Laying eggs, working hard,
One, two, three, four, five,
Count the eggs while they arrive!

lengalengas.title: One Potato, Two Potato
lengalengas.text:
One potato, two potato, three potato, four,
Five potato, six potato, seven potato, more!

lengalengas.title: Ring Around the Rosie
lengalengas.text:
Ring around the rosie,
A pocket full of posies,
Ashes, ashes,
We all fall down!

lengalengas.title: Engine, Engine Number Nine
lengalengas.text:
Engine, engine, number nine,
Running down Chicago line,
If the train runs off the track,
Do you want your money back?

lengalengas.title: Bubble Gum
lengalengas.text:
Bubble gum, bubble gum, in a dish,
How many pieces do you wish?

lengalengas.title: Star Light, Star Bright
lengalengas.text:
Star light, star bright,
First star I see tonight,
I wish I may, I wish I might,
Have the wish I wish tonight.

lengalengas.title: Doctor Foster
lengalengas.text:
Doctor Foster went to Gloucester,
In a shower of rain,
He stepped in a puddle right up to his middle,
And never went there again.

lengalengas.title: Hickory Dickory Dock
lengalengas.text:
Hickory dickory dock,
The mouse ran up the clock,
The clock struck one,
The mouse ran down, hickory dickory dock!

lengalengas.title: This Little Piggy
lengalengas.text:
This little piggy went to market,
This little piggy stayed home,
This little piggy had roast beef,
This little piggy had none.

lengalengas.title: Rain Before Seven
lengalengas.text:
Rain before seven,
Clear by eleven,
Sun in the morning,
A sunny day's warning.

lengalengas.title: One, Two, Buckle My Shoe
lengalengas.text:
One, two, buckle my shoe,
Three, four, knock at the door,
Five, six, pick up sticks,
Seven, eight, lay them straight!

travalinguas.title: She Sells Seashells
travalinguas.text: She sells seashells by the seashore.

travalinguas.title: Peter Piper
travalinguas.text: Peter Piper picked a peck of pickled peppers.

travalinguas.title: How Much Wood
travalinguas.text: How much wood would a woodchuck chuck if a woodchuck could chuck wood?

travalinguas.title: Fuzzy Wuzzy
travalinguas.text: Fuzzy Wuzzy was a bear, Fuzzy Wuzzy had no hair.

travalinguas.title: Betty Botter
travalinguas.text: Betty Botter bought some butter, but she said the butter's bitter.

travalinguas.title: Six Slippery Snails
travalinguas.text: Six slippery snails slid slowly seaward.

travalinguas.title: Red Lorry, Yellow Lorry
travalinguas.text: Red lorry, yellow lorry, red lorry, yellow lorry.

travalinguas.title: Unique New York
travalinguas.text: Unique New York, unique New York, unique New York.

travalinguas.title: Toy Boat
travalinguas.text: Toy boat, toy boat, toy boat.

travalinguas.title: Black Bug's Blood
travalinguas.text: A black bug bit a big black bear.

travalinguas.title: Chuck's Truck
travalinguas.text: Chuck's truck struck a truck full of stuck trucks.

travalinguas.title: Greek Grapes
travalinguas.text: Greek grapes, Greek grapes, Greek grapes.

travalinguas.title: She Sees Cheese
travalinguas.text: She sees cheese, she seeks cheese.

travalinguas.title: Truly Rural
travalinguas.text: Truly rural, truly rural, truly rural.

travalinguas.title: Freshly Fried Fish
travalinguas.text: Freshly fried fish, freshly fried fish, freshly fried fish.

rimas.title: The Sneaky Cat
rimas.text:
My cat is quite the sneaky one,
Sleeps all day, avoids the sun,
At night he jumps up, quick and light,
To hunt the whole wide world at night!

rimas.title: The Bright Sun
rimas.text:
The sun wakes up at break of day,
Paints the sky in golden ray,
Warms the earth and every hill,
And smiles down on us until.

rimas.title: The Friendly Rain
rimas.text:
Rain is tapping on the glass,
Tip, tap, tip, so soft and slow,
Waters garden, waters grass,
Then off to somewhere new to go.

rimas.title: My Family
rimas.text:
Mom and dad and sister too,
Together make my family true,
A hug at home, I'm never alone,
There's no place better than my home.

rimas.title: The Flower Garden
rimas.text:
In the garden, colors bloom,
Roses, tulips, sweet perfume,
Butterflies dance flower to flower,
While bees hum on for hours.

rimas.title: Good Night, Moon
rimas.text:
Good night, moon so round and bright,
Lighting up the stars tonight,
Sleep the earth, sleep the sand,
Until the sun's new day at hand.

rimas.title: The Early Bird
rimas.text:
The little bird sings at dawn's first light,
Announcing that the day's in sight,
It flies up high, brave and free,
Into the bluest sky I see.

rimas.title: Golden Autumn
rimas.text:
The leaves fall softly, gold and brown,
They paint a carpet on the ground,
The wind loves playing all around,
With every leaf that flutters down.

rimas.title: Cold Winter
rimas.text:
Winter brings the frosty air,
Covers the earth in white so fair,
We sip warm cocoa by the fire,
And watch the snowflakes drift up higher.

rimas.title: Spring Has Come
rimas.text:
Springtime wakes with gentle cheer,
The trees are blooming, flowers near,
The fields smell sweet, the sun feels near,
A warmer season now is here.

rimas.title: Summer at the Beach
rimas.text:
In summer we go to the shore,
To play in sand and waves galore,
The sun shines bright, the tide will pour,
An invitation to explore.

rimas.title: My Faithful Dog
rimas.text:
My dog runs fast and barks with glee,
Chasing balls so happily,
He wags his tail, never tired,
My best friend, always admired.

rimas.title: The Golden Fish
rimas.text:
In the tank it swims so slow,
A little fish with sunny glow,
It loves the water, to and fro,
Swimming gently, soft and low.

rimas.title: Dear Grandma
rimas.text:
Grandma tells stories every night,
With a soft voice and a hug so tight,
She always keeps a sweet treat near,
Full of love for all so dear.

rimas.title: Forest Walk
rimas.text:
In the forest the wind does blow,
Among the trees so tall, they grow,
The squirrel jumps and won't stay slow,
While the river keeps its flow.
